name: Kriftel (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Kriftel (a blue wavy bar on yellow above a white wheel on red).
history: Municipal flag of Kriftel; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Kriftel arms — wavy bar and wheel
